card.name: Kidney and heart lab-change wording
card.fires_on: The end of "creatinine" (the "inine" piece) and nearby words in sentences about changes in kidney or heart measures, such as BUN, renal function or LVEF.

modes.label: Creatinine rise
modes.description: The closing part of "creatinine" in statements about increases in serum creatinine or BUN with kidney problems.

modes.label: Organ function change wording
modes.description: Words describing change or recovery in kidney or heart function, such as renal function, LVEF or edema resolving.
